title: Rewrite the family-4 record in filter-logic-conformance.ts: the 2026-08-10 exclude ruling was withdrawn — include re-affirmed
body:
Follow-up ordered by the 2026-08-10 maintainer ruling on #5299 (recorded there in full). Filed by the `domain:engine-core` seat; dispatchable immediately.

## The fact

PR #7391 (`5f7669e0c`) recorded the 07:33Z exclude ruling as a *"RULED but not yet enrolled"* family-4 note in `packages/spec/src/data/filter-logic-conformance.ts`'s header, with matching "ruled target" annotations in `packages/formula/src/matches-filter-not-null-safe.test.ts` and the two driver-memory pin files. **Minutes after it merged, the maintainer withdrew cells 1/3 of that ruling and re-affirmed #5298's include direction** (`$ne`/`$nin`/`$notContains` match no-value rows) as the platform semantics.

So the header currently proclaims a ruled target that is no longer ruled — a standing declared≠enforced contradiction, in the exact file whose job is to be the single source of truth.

## The work (XS, annotation-only, ⛔ zero behaviour)

1. Rewrite the family-4 header note: the exclude direction was ruled 2026-08-10 07:33Z, measured (the eleven-surface table), and **withdrawn the same day**; include is re-affirmed platform semantics. Keep the measurement table reference — it is the record of *why*.
2. Flip the matching "ruled target / superseded direction" annotations in the formula and driver-memory pin files to say include is the affirmed direction. ⛔ The pins' **assertions stay byte-identical** — they already assert the include row sets.
3. The four enrolled `d`-column cases' pointers (added by #7391) likewise updated: they state the *affirmed* direction, not a superseded one.

⛔ No case rows added or removed; `check:driver-conformance` must be byte-identical before/after. Tests-only+comments ⇒ read the changeset gates for the `skip-changeset` vs patch decision. `packages/spec` touched ⇒ all 9 spec gates + the PM files the #6017 declaration.

Refs #5299, #5298, #5146, PR #7391 (`5f7669e0c`).
